Every model is equipped with: Flesh hooks, Scything talons, Piercing claws.
• Each Lictor may be upgraded to one of the following specialisation:
• May additionally select any number of Basic and Advanced Biomorphs (see Armory).
Deep Strike, Hit & Run, Infiltrate, Move Through Cover, Stealth, Squadron, Terrifying(-1), Use Cover
Assassin: If all attacks are resolved against a single model, the model may re-roll all to hit rolls.

Chameleonic Skin: The model does not scatter when being set up via Deep Strike. Additionally, instead of using a "Move & Shoot" command, it always uses a "Charge" command and may still perform a 6" Charge move after being set up via Deep Strike.
Neurolictor: Select one enemy unit within 12" during your activation. The target must pass a Leadership test or gain one Battleshock token.
